subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should these 14 action revisions be accepted together for OpenClaw's credentialed, release, scanning, and Codex-agent workflows after focused privileged-path validation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but the protected security signal and event-only credentialed workflows require human ownership of the supply-chain and operational boundary.

options.title: Verify and land the batch
options.body: Confirm upstream revision provenance and run representative privileged workflow paths, then merge the unchanged full-SHA batch.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate GitHub App token, Docker credential, and Codex Action updates from lower-risk setup and labeling actions for narrower validation.

options.title: Pause the refresh
options.body: Keep the existing pins until an owner can review upstream changes and exercise the affected release and automation workflows.

recommendation.title: Verify and land the batch
recommendation.body: Confirm upstream revision provenance and run representative privileged workflow paths, then merge the unchanged full-SHA batch.

likelyOwner.reason: The broadest merge risk is concentrated in Docker release and repository automation workflows with recent ownership evidence tied to this person.
